CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetTempFile

Creates a new, empty file with a unique name in the given directory and returns its full path. The name is made from the first three characters of the prefix, some random characters and the extension .tmp.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetTempFile(directory, prefix)

Parameters

directory
The directory in which to create the file, usually GetTempDirectory().
prefix
A prefix for the file name; only the first three characters are used.

Returns

The absolute path of the new file.

Usage

The file really exists when the function returns, so two requests running at the same time can never get the same name. Delete the file with CFFILE ACTION="Delete" when you are done.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET TmpFile = GetTempFile(GetTempDirectory(), "kfs")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Created: <TT>#GetFileFromPath(TmpFile)#</TT>
<P>Exists right away: #FileExists(TmpFile)#
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFFILE ACTION="APPEND" FILE="#TmpFile#" OUTPUT="Line one">
<CFFILE ACTION="APPEND" FILE="#TmpFile#" OUTPUT="Line two">
<CFFILE ACTION="READ" FILE="#TmpFile#" VARIABLE="Text">
<CFFILE ACTION="DELETE" FILE="#TmpFile#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Contents:<PRE>#Text#</PRE>
<P>After CFFILE ACTION="DELETE": #FileExists(TmpFile)#
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetTempDirectory, FileExists, CFFILE
